objects.query: SELECT Code, DataType, Description, Id, Name, Status FROM AttributePicklist WHERE Code = 'ENT-USER-BAND' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Code, DisplayValue, Id, IsDefault, Name, PicklistId, Picklist.Code, Sequence, Status, Value FROM AttributePicklistValue WHERE Picklist.Code = 'ENT-USER-BAND' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT Code, DataType, Description, DeveloperName, Id, IsActive, IsRequired, Label, Name, PicklistId, Picklist.Code FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code IN ('ENT_NAMED_USERS', 'ENT_TOTAL_NAMED_USERS') ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Code, Description, Id, Name FROM AttributeCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'AC-ENT-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, Id, AttributeCategory.Code, AttributeDefinition.Code FROM AttributeCategoryAttribute WHERE AttributeCategory.Code LIKE 'AC-ENT-%' ORDER BY AttributeCategory.Code ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC
SELECT Code, Id, Name, ParentProductClassificationId, Status FROM ProductClassification WHERE Code LIKE 'PC-ENT-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, DefaultValue, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, Name, ProductClassificationId, Sequence, Status FROM ProductClassificationAttr WHERE ProductClassification.Code LIKE 'PC-ENT-%' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT BasedOnId, BasedOn.Code, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, Family, Id, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, StockKeepingUnit, Type FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' OR StockKeepingUnit = 'QB-DB' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, DefaultValue, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, Name, Product2Id, ProductClassificationAttributeId, Sequence, Status, AttributeDefinition.Code, ProductClassificationAttribute.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductAttributeDefinition WHERE AttributeDefinition.Code IN ('ENT_NAMED_USERS', 'ENT_TOTAL_NAMED_USERS') ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC
SELECT DoesAutoRenewAssetByDefault, Id, Name, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType, Status FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'DEMO-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
SELECT AssociatedProductRoleCat, Id, MainProductRoleCat, Name FROM ProductRelationshipType ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Code, Description, Id, MaxBundleComponents, MinBundleComponents, Name, ParentProductId, Sequence FROM ProductComponentGroup WHERE Code LIKE 'PCG-ENT-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT ChildProductId, ChildProductRole, DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild, Id, IsComponentRequired, IsDefaultComponent, IsQuantityEditable, MaxQuantity, MinQuantity, ParentProductId, ParentProductRole, ProductComponentGroupId, ProductRelationshipTypeId, Quantity, QuoteVisibility, Sequence, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ProductComponentGroup.Code, ProductRelationshipType.Name FROM ProductRelatedComponent WHERE ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit = 'DEMO-CS-CLOUD' ORDER BY ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductComponentGroup.Code ASC, ProductRelationshipType.Name ASC
SELECT CatalogType, Code, Description, Id, Name FROM ProductCatalog WHERE Code = 'CAT-ENTIRELY' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, Id, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory WHERE Catalog.Code = 'CAT-ENTIRELY' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT CatalogId, Id, IsPrimaryCategory, ProductCategoryId, ProductId, ProductCategory.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductCategoryProduct WHERE Catalog.Code = 'CAT-ENTIRELY' ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
